_comment: TEMPLATE — copy to the repo root as profile.json (git-ignored) and replace with YOUR data. All values here are the shared 'Test Dummy' fixture identity; never commit a real profile.json.

work_authorization._note: Set to match your real authorization before any live use.

experience._note: Fictional value for the dummy identity.
experience.year_questions_rule: Answer years-of-experience questions from this number.

eeo_demographic._note: EEO answers are optional. The agent never invents these — leave blank or 'Decline to self-identify' unless you set them yourself.

work_preferences.notice_period_dropdown_note: Pick the closest option to 2 weeks.

salary_expectation.rule: Give a market range for the role/location; never a single hard number if a range is allowed.

current_salary.rule: Decline where legal; otherwise give a reasonable placeholder.

how_did_you_hear_about_this_job._note: Pick the first available option in priority order; never claim a referral you don't have.

resume_is_source_of_truth._note: These mirror the resume so form answers stay consistent with it.
